description: Edit one or more existing referrers (refer_ids) in a single call: rename the hostname, change the type (ALLOW|BLOCK), and/or move them between scopes. scope='library' makes the domain apply to the whole library (omit folder_ids). scope='folder' makes it apply to the listed folder_ids (required and non-empty, the backend computes the add/remove diff). All refer_ids must belong to the same hostname. Moving a folder domain to scope='library' recreates it as a library domain that starts 'pending' until it is active. Returns { message, hostname, type, scope, renamed, folders_added, folders_removed, refers }. On error the API returns { errCode, errMsg }. library_id is resolved automatically when omitted.

folder_ids.description: Target folder UUIDs — required when scope='folder' (max 50)

hostname.description: Domain hostname without protocol, e.g. 'example.com' or wildcard '*.cliente.com'

library_id.description: Library UUID. Resolved from GET /library when omitted.

refer_ids.description: Referrer UUIDs to edit (all must be the same hostname) (max 50)

type.description: ALLOW = whitelist (only listed domains play); BLOCK = blacklist (listed domains are denied)

name: panda_update_folder_refer
title: Update/Move Domain Referrers (mass-edit)
